name: architecture-fidelity
description: Keeps codebase architecture coherent as features and variants are added.

interface.shortDescription: Keep architecture coherent as code evolves.
interface.longDescription: Automatically applies a significance gate to meaningful code changes, then guides agents to reuse existing responsibilities, identify proven abstraction and specialization opportunities, model domain options explicitly, preserve boundaries, and maintain repository-side architectural memory without duplicating lint rules.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature with architectural fidelity.
Check whether this completed diff warrants an architecture fidelity pass.
Review this change for architectural drift.
Find the right reuse or abstraction seam here.
